szoveg_eredeti:
You can win $20K by building a demo, training a model, or creating a dataset with Beam by Reflection !

Plus, we're giving $25 hub credits to the first 400 to take part, just find the link in the page below. 

Prizes are split across 3 winners that we'll choose after the challenge ends on Monday, November 2nd.

Rules: Build something cool with beam and drop it on the discussion! Anything that might be helpful to the world or a cool demo is allowed:

- You could make a demo that uses the Beam model on Spaces
- You could quantize it for your favorite hardware
- You could generate a synthetic dataset for your favorite problem
- You could build an RL environment with or for Beam
- You could benchmark Beam and share the results.
- You could surprise us!

If you build something with Beam, then share it on the Hub to enter the challenge. We’ll collect all the links, select the best, and reach out to winners.

 https://lnkd.in/eSgAYzsQ
